cream-paper.description: Primary surface — warm white, lightly toothed. Dark mode inverts with ink-black.

ink-black.description: Display + headline. Dark mode inverts with cream-paper.

saffron.description: Sole saturated accent — buttons, callouts. Desaturated in dark mode for ambient contrast.

pomegranate.description: Secondary deep accent — PKU / Crystal-by-Epics range only. Gravity color.
